hints.tr: Başlangıç satırı yöneticisi olmayan çalışan: `SELECT id, name, 0 AS level FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL`.
hints.en: The starting row is the employee with no manager: `SELECT id, name, 0 AS level FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL`.

hints.tr: `UNION ALL`'dan sonra CTE kendi adını kullanıyor: yöneticisi zincirde olanları getir, kademeyi bir artır — `JOIN chain c ON e.manager_id = c.id`, `c.level + 1`.
hints.en: After `UNION ALL` the CTE uses its own name: bring back the employees whose manager is already in the chain and add one to the level — `JOIN chain c ON e.manager_id = c.id`, `c.level + 1`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
WITH chain AS (
    SELECT id, name, 0 AS level
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.id, e.name, c.level + 1
    FROM employees e
    JOIN chain c ON e.manager_id = c.id
)
SELECT id, name, level
FROM chain
ORDER BY level, id;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
WITH chain AS (
    SELECT id, name, 0 AS level
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.id, e.name, c.level + 1
    FROM employees e
    JOIN chain c ON e.manager_id = c.id
)
SELECT id, name, level
FROM chain
ORDER BY level, id;
```

hint.tr: Özyinelemeli `WITH` iki parçalı: başlangıç satırları, `UNION ALL`, sonra kendini çağıran parça.
hint.en: A recursive `WITH` has two parts: the starting rows, `UNION ALL`, then the part that refers to itself.
